announcements.headline: First Everfex Settlement Agreement signed
announcements.insight: Following the November proposal, this settlement finalizes the Everfex restructuring. Shareholders should monitor the implementation of these agreed terms.

announcements.headline: Operations update, 1st proposed Everfex settlement
announcements.insight: Following the September GM and October restructuring filing, this update marks the first proposed settlement in the Everfex process, a critical step for shareholders.

announcements.headline: Everfex Restructuring Filing
announcements.insight: Everfex restructuring filing follows September GM results and half-year results. This suggests a significant corporate action impacting shareholder value.

announcements.headline: Result of Requisitioned General Meeting
announcements.insight: The requisitioned general meeting concluded. Shareholders should monitor the subsequent half-year results released in September for financial context.

announcements.headline: Half-Year results; six months ended 30 June 2026
announcements.insight: Fiinu has published half-year results amidst an active requisitioned general meeting process initiated in July. Shareholders must weigh these financials against the governance changes and member statements released in August and September.

announcements.headline: Requisitioned GM, Member Statement, Fiinu response
announcements.insight: Following the July requisition notice, this GM addresses shareholder concerns raised in August. The September operational update may provide context for these governance developments.

announcements.headline: Operational Update
announcements.insight: An operational update follows a requisitioned general meeting in August. Shareholders should watch for outcomes of the requested governance changes.

announcements.headline: Further re Voting Instructions For GM
announcements.insight: Fiinu issued further voting instructions for the requisitioned General Meeting following the July circular. Shareholders should monitor the outcome of this vote.

announcements.headline: Publication of Circular:Notice of Requisitioned GM
announcements.insight: Fiinu is holding a requisitioned general meeting following the receipt of a requisition notice in July. Shareholders should watch for the outcome of this vote.

announcements.headline: Receipt of Requisition Notice
announcements.insight: Fiinu received a requisition notice following its July AGM results. Shareholders should monitor for potential changes to the board or agenda arising from this procedural step.

announcements.headline: Result of Annual General Meeting
announcements.insight: The AGM results follow the June notice and July shareholder response. Shareholders should monitor for any subsequent governance actions.

announcements.headline: Response to Shareholder Letter
announcements.insight: Fiinu responds to a shareholder letter following its Annual Report posting. Shareholders should monitor for further governance developments.

announcements.headline: Posting of Annual Report & Accounts & AGM Notice
announcements.insight: Fiinu has posted its Annual Report & Accounts and issued an AGM notice. Shareholders should watch for voting outcomes at the upcoming meeting.
